subject: SIG / SOC2: CI/CD and secrets evidence - rotation + deploy approvals
messages:
From: Emily Zhang <emily.z@assessor.io>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: security.audits@finservco.com
Date: Tue, 16 Apr 2029 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: SIG request - CI/CD approvals, secrets rotation evidence

Hi Aditya / Lauren,

Thanks for taking this. As part of FinServCo's SIG submission we need a compact evidence bundle that shows:
- secrets rotation cadence and owners for the last 12 months (who rotated, on what schedule),
- CI/CD change approval trail for releases (PR -> approval -> deploy) for prod services serving customer data,
- a short description of emergency change process for quick rollbacks.

Can you provide the minimal set of artifacts we can upload to the SIG portal? Prefer CSV/PDF + a short README (1 page). If possible we need the artifacts by Thu, Apr 18 EOD PST.

If there's a preferred place to drop the files (Drive link / DocuSign link for attestation), send that too.

Cheers,
Emily
Emily Zhang
Security Assessor (FinServCo)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.z@assessor.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Apr 2029 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG request - CI/CD approvals, secrets rotation evidence

Hi Emily —

Thanks for the clear checklist. We're assembling the package now. Quick summary of what we will provide by Thu EOD PST:

1) rotation_logs_2028-Q4.csv — export from our secrets-management service showing rotation timestamps, rotation owner ID (internal), and vault key version.
2) ci-approval-audit-trail.pdf — consolidated PDF showing PR IDs, approvers, CI job run IDs, and deploy timestamps for the last 6 months for services in scope.
3) README_SIG_upload.txt — short notes describing mapping between our internal IDs and the CSV columns, and the emergency rollback playbook pointer.

Questions:
- For the CI approval trail, do you need raw PR diffs or is the approval metadata sufficient? We can include PR links if requested (internal links will be redacted unless you have bridge access).
- Is the emergency change rollforward history (two examples) sufficient or do you need a full runbook?

We'll place the artifacts in a shared Drive folder and send a DocuSign attestation link if you need a signed statement. Attaching the two files we already have as stubs — full export will be in Drive.

Attachments: rotation_logs_2028-Q4.csv (stub), ci-approval-audit-trail.pdf (stub)

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Head of Trusted Ops, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0193

From: Emily Zhang <emily.z@assessor.io>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, security.audits@finservco.com
Date: Wed, 17 Apr 2029 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG request - CI/CD approvals, secrets rotation evidence

Aditya,

This looks good — approval metadata and links are fine; we don't need raw diffs. A couple of specific asks before we finalize the upload:

- Can you include a small sample PR (sanitized) that shows the owner, reviewer, and the approval timestamp? That helps our reviewers validate the approval model maps to your CI jobs.
- For secrets rotation, please include the policy (rotation_interval_days) as a one-line excerpt in the README and indicate any exceptions.
- We'll need one signed attestation that the exported data is complete for the period stated. DocuSign is preferred.

If you can get those in by Thu morning we'll run the SIG portal upload that afternoon.

Thanks again — Emily

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.z@assessor.io>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Apr 2029 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG request - CI/CD approvals, secrets rotation evidence

Emily —

Attached are the final items we uploaded to the Drive folder (link below). Summary of what's included:

- rotation_logs_2028-Q4.csv — complete rotation audit for Oct-Dec 2028 (columns: secret_id, last_rotated_at, rotation_owner, rotation_method, vault_version). We redacted internal tokens.
- ci-approval-audit-trail.pdf — consolidated approvals for prod services (Jan-Apr 2029) with PR ID, author, reviewer(s), approval timestamp, and CI pipeline job ID.
- sample_pr_sanitized.txt — single PR that demonstrates the owner/reviewer/approval flow (sensitive lines redacted).
- README_SIG_upload.txt — contains: rotation_interval_days=90; exceptions: payment-service (30 days due to PCI), emergency skips logged with ticket IDs. Also includes the mapping and explanation of how to validate the CI job IDs.
- docsign_attestation_link.txt — DocuSign envelope URL for signature.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cCI_CD_EVIDENCE
DocuSign: https://docusign.net/envelope/ABC123

If you want a quick 20-min sync to walk through the artifacts and point reviewers to the right pages, I can join at 2pm PT today.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance Program Manager, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0118
